[[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]}} |demonym= |cities=[[Shanpan]] {{C|[[Capital/Legends|capital]]}} |imports= |exports=High-grade [[Plastic/Legends|plastics]] |affiliation= }} {{Quote|''Shawda Clubb sandwich''
This popular sandwich boasts sliced Manpha-fowl, nuna bacon, Revwien lettuce and topato.|Dexter Jettster, menu for Dex's Diner|{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}}} '''Manpha''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Seitia sector/Legends|Seitia sector]]. A [[Water/Legends|humid]] world with marshlands and [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] on its single continent, it was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibian]] [[Shawda Ubb/Legends|Shawda Ubb]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Shawda Ubb primarily lived in many small communities scattered across Manpha's swamplands and harvested [[petroleum]] bubbling up out of the swamps. The substance was shipped to [[Factory/Legends|factories]] in Manpha's sole [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] community, the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Shanpan]], where it was processed into [[Plastic/Legends|plastics]] for export offworld. Atypically for a Shawda Ubb, the Manpha native [[Rappertunie/Legends|Rapotwanalantonee Tivtotolon]] desired to travel beyond Manpha. In order to earn [[Currency/Legends|money]] to fulfill that goal, Tivtotolon [[Musician/Legends|played]] [[Music/Legends|music]] and carried news to isolated communities across Manpha's continent. Eventually, the Shawda Ubb traveled to Shanpan, where he adopted the stage name "Rappertunie," and when the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] and the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]] visited Manpha at some point by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Rappertunie joined the [[Band/Legends|band]] and accompanied Jabba and the musicians off Manpha. ==Description== Manpha was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Manpha system/Legends|Manpha system]], a part of the [[Seitia sector/Legends|Seitia sector]] in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was situated on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], which connected it to the [[Sil'Lume system/Legends|Sil'Lume system]] as well as the [[Terminus system/Legends|Terminus system]] of the [[Kallea sector/Legends|Kallea sector]]. A small world, Manpha had a single continent that featured marshlands and [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]]. It constantly [[Water/Legends|rained]] on the planet, and rich [[petroleum]] bubbled up out of its swamps. Manpha's marshes featured swamp [[Grass/Legends|grasses]] and [[Fish/Legends|fish]]. The planet also shared its name with the creature known as [[Manpha-fowl]]. ==History== [[Realspace/Legends|Space]] surrounding Manpha was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[3000 BBY]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was situated outside of the borders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], although during the first campaigns of that conflict in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] the Republic's [[Nineteenth Army|Nineteenth Sector Army]] was nevertheless tasked with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in Manpha's vicinity. By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Manpha was not a part of the territory controlled by the Republic's [[Declaration of a New Order|successor]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' — Based on corresponding data from [[Manpha system/Legends|Manpha system]] [[File:RappertunieCrop-DK.png|thumb|left|300px|The musician Rappertunie was native to Manpha.]] From the [[Local day/Legends|day]] he [[Reproduction/Legends|hatched]] from his [[Egg/Legends|egg]], the Manpha native [[Rappertunie/Legends|Rapotwanalantonee Tivtotolon]]{{InsiderCite|67|Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band}} had an obssessive urge—in contrast to the rest of the planet's [[Shawda Ubb/Legends|Shawda Ubb]] [[Species/Legends|species]]—to travel{{FactFile|75|MAX 7-10|Max Rebo Band}} and explore the entire [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], one planet at a time. After Tivtotolon learned about the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Shanpan]], Manpha's sole [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] community, the young Shawda Ubb devoted his every [[Sleep/Legends|waking]] [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] to earning enough [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to travel there. He traveled extensively through the marsh communities of Manpha's continent, getting [[Currency/Legends|paid]] for [[Musician/Legends|playing]] [[Music/Legends|music]] and carrying news to isolated villages. By early adulthood, Tivtotolon had saved enough money to use a planetary [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to travel to Shanpan. There, the Shawda Ubb musician played in many [[Band/Legends|bands]], taking the more [[Alien/Legends|alien]]-friendly stage name "Rappertunie." In Shanpan's [[Cantina/Legends|bars]] and [[Casino/Legends|casinos]], Rappertunie conversed with visiting alien—predominantly [[Human/Legends|Human]]—[[Merchant/Legends|merchants]], and for several [[Standard year/Legends|years]], he sought a way to travel off Manpha. At some point by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],{{FactFile|75|MAX 7-10|Max Rebo Band}} establishes that [[Rappertunie/Legends|Rappertunie]] left Manpha after [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] visited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates Jabba's [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|death]] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] and the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]], which formed a part of Jabba's entourage, visited Manpha. Rappertunie infiltrated the [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] suite the Max Rebo Band was staying at and displayed his musical talents, which impressed the band's nominal leader, [[Max Rebo/Legends|Max Rebo]], and ultimately gave the Shawda Ubb the opportunity to accompany the musicians and Jabba offworld. At some point no earlier than [[36 ABY]], Manpha was mentioned in a [[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species (book)|guide]] to various species of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] that was based on the research notes of [[Xenoanthropologist/Legends|sentientologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]].''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' ==Inhabitants== {{Main|Shawda Ubb/Legends}} [[File:ShawdaUbb-AlienEncounters.png|thumb|right|295px|Manpha was the homeworld of the Shawda Ubb species.]] Manpha was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Shawda Ubb, a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibian]] species originally descended from [[Bird/Legends|avians]]. The Shawda Ubb were well-adapted for their planet's humid conditions, having evolved ridges on their foreheads that kept out rainwater out of their [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. The population of the Manpha [[Star system/Legends|system]] around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] numbered between ten and one hundred million. The Shawda Ubb inhabited hundreds of thousands of small towns and villages scattered across the marshes and swamps of Manpha's continent. Those communities utilized a relatively low [[Technology level|level]] of technology. The [[Growdi Harmonique/Legends|Growdi Harmonique]] was a musical instrument originating on Manpha. Many of the Shawda Ubb communities practiced [[Oil/Legends|oil]]-refining, pumping into barrels the petroleum bubbling up out of the planet's swamps. The substance was sold to national oil companies based in Manpha's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city, Shanpan, where [[Factory/Legends|factories]] processed the oil into high-grade [[Plastic/Legends|plastics]] that were subsequently exported offworld. Shanpan was the only spaceport community on Manpha, and a large network of [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Transport/Legends|transports]] and shuttles serviced the Shawda Ubb oil companies. A significant industry was also in place for transporting Shawda Ubb [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] across the planet. ==Behind the scenes== Manpha was introduced in the [[1997]] ''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'', which was published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The planet was given its first visual depiction in the [[2006]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'', which was written by [[Ann Margaret Lewis (real person)|Ann Margaret Lewis]] and [[Helen Keier]] and illustrated by [[Chris Trevas]] and [[William O'Connor]]. The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Manpha system, and therefore the planet, in grid square K-20. ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'' {{1stm}} *''[[Alien Encounters]]'' *{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Rappertunie}} *{{InsiderCite|67|Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band}} *{{FactFile|75|MAX 7-10|Max Rebo Band}} *''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' {{1stp}} *''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' *''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' *{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} *{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} {{C|in [[Manpha-fowl]]'s name}} *''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' *{{DB|character|rappertunie|Rappertunie}} *''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' *[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] *''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File Collector's Guide & Galaxy Chart]]'' *{{SW|url=news/this-is-podracing-sports-in-the-star-wars-galaxy-part-1|series=Sports in the Star Wars Galaxy|text=Part 1: This Is Podracing|nolive=1}} *[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]] *[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]] ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Manpha}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Manpha#legends |fr=Manpha/Légendes |nl=Manpha }} [[Category:Locations along the Corellian Trade Spine]] [[Category:Planets in the Outer Rim Territories]] [[Category:Planets in the Western Reaches]] [[Category:Seitia sector locations]] [[Category:Swamp planets]]
